sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $9 base fee plus $5 per hour. A customer's total bill was $24. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 25 m, then descends another 13 m, then ascends 15 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 52 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $880 rate will decrease by 5%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 10 ft long, 5 ft wide, and 8 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 14, 29, 44, 59, 74. The mean is 44. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 4 by 4 units has a volume of 74 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Yes; the volume is 74 cubic units.
No; the volume is 75 cubic units, not 74.
No; the volume is 64 cubic units, not 74.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $15 base fee plus $3 per hour. A customer's total bill was $39. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 13 m, then descends another 10 m, then ascends 25 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 29 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $660 rate will increase by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 8 ft long, 7 ft wide, and 2 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 19, 44, 69, 94, 119. The mean is 69. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 5 by 4 by 4 units has a volume of 13 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 80 cubic units, not 13.
Yes; the volume is 13 cubic units.
No; the volume is 14 cubic units, not 13.
